entities.summary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is a sovereign nation in Central Africa, Africa. Its capital is Kinshasa. Official languages include French. Government: Unitary semi-presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 105.0 million. Area: 2,344,858 km². Comprehensive index for the Democratic Republic of the Congo covering Bantu migration, Kongo, Luba, and Lunda kingdoms, King Leopold's Congo Free State (rubber terror), Belgian Congo, Lumumba assassination, Mobutu/Zaire, Congo Wars (Africa's World War), Kabila era, and conflict minerals.
